# Rules: tide-tables

## Rules
<!-- eva:rules:start -->
- Never commit station keys; use the fake ones in testdata. <!-- r:1 --> s:9c41aa07#3
- Times are UTC with an explicit offset: 2026-11-04T06:00:00+00:00. <!-- r:2 --> s:9c41aa07#8
<!-- eva:rules:end -->

## Notes
Kept by hand: ask before renaming a table.
